description: Metadata-only contract for onboarding a new case-study domain into the v2 platform interface. Passing this contract does not enable execution.
security_rules: Onboarding configs are JSON metadata only.
No Python expressions, eval, exec, shell commands, arbitrary imports, or dynamic module paths are allowed.
All paths must be repository-relative and must not contain traversal.
Raw and local-only artifacts cannot be tracked.
Config cannot grant execution permission, network access, raw-data access, model training, or canonical overwrite.
Passing onboarding validation does not prove scientific validity.
policy_rules: A time-aware validation policy requires a time_key or an explicit unavailable reason.
A group-aware validation policy requires group_keys or an explicit unavailable reason.
Combined asset/time validation requires both time_key and group_keys.
A trust policy is required before a case study can become an execution candidate.
production_ready is not an onboarding status.
